rationale: M37.21 #610 groovy: pins JD19 (family lesson from java) AND JD18 (family lesson from java/scala). JD19: overrides through a NON-declaring ancestor (BlackVal extends Black extends Node, Black declares no val) resolve at conf 1.0 to the true ancestor Node.val; the pre-fix BFS fell through to the pass-3 first-parent guess, fabricating BlackVal.val -> Black.val at 0.5 (forbidden). JD18: an anonymous inner class body (new Runnable() {...}) declares an anonymous_Runnable Class symbol owned by Tree whose members attribute to the anonymous type (contains anonymous_Runnable->run); the pre-fix leak attributed run to Tree (forbidden).
